entities.summary: Natural language processing (NLP) is the processing of natural language information by a computer. NLP is a subfield of computer science and is closely associated with artificial intelligence. NLP is also related to information retrieval, knowledge representation, computational linguistics, and linguistics more broadly. natural language processing is a academic discipline. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 73 language editions of Wikipedia.
